pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Tessellated polygonal regions with sharp pixel gradients. Edge geometry is notably angular on the upper flank, while patches become smaller, more fragmented, and densely clustered toward the posterior and lower flank regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming clear junction nodes (3-way and 4-way). Path thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing in areas where patch density increases near the lower extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, indicating a short, continuous mane structure.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct vertical band of hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the central flank, characterized by a darker, more diffused appearance than the surrounding standard pelage patches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large vertical dark lesion or area of thickened, atypical skin texture present on the mid-flank, consistent with localized physical trauma or parasitic disruption.
